normalization_notes: Eighteen text targets on the complete single source page; no numeric ID.

This is a separate representation-authorization form, not another filled instance of the name-certificate application. Both participate in the same foundation-registration process, which is explicitly retained as related-source metadata, not claimed as institutional diversity.

Retain all three sections, the complete authorization clause, both numbered footnotes, and institutional header/footer. Superscript footnote markers are flattened to 1 and 2, not interpreted as fields. Decorative coat of arms omitted.
Source line-based fields are given their own cells, keeping paired address lines and the three-column notification rows. The combined Lugar y fecha source box remains one field, next to Firma.
Don.1 retains its visible footnote marker. The D.N.I/CIF nº label retains the printed number prefix. Dotted input leaders are not extra fields.
Synthetic grantor and representative are distinct, all identifiers explicitly fictitious, and signature is a typed placeholder without legal validity. Exact anchors refer to PyMuPDF sort=False text.
